test_title: PYST 15: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by three conclusions number I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follows(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All diaries are books.

All page are diaries.

Conclusions:

I. All pages are books.

II. Some books are diaries.

III. All books are pages.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusion I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb58491f5f5c1005219cfbf4b94924c06f30f938bda1552b8a22b66152811d92.png] 

Conclusions:

1. All pages are books → True (It is clear from the given statement that all the pages are diaries and all the diaries are books so all pages are books will also be correct).

2. Some books are diaries → True (It is clear that all diaries are books, so some books are also diaries will be right).

3. All books are pages → False (It is clear that all pages are diaries and all the diaries are books but we can't say that all the books are pages it can be or cannot be because no direct relation is given from the book side).

Thus, **Only conclusion I and II follow.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

Suppose for an Example: All A are B.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab79005e5895f30563c1890a00ef2f56cc4dd4037f4e73e5263bdadf4f935695.png] 

If we go from In to Out means from A to B then cases with All and some will be true like All A are B and Some A are B.

But if we go Out to In then only cases with Some will be true and All will be can't say like Some B are A will be true but All B are A will be can't say.
